        closeLayer();
    });

    $("#showelectinfo").click(function(){
        initscpage(this.title);
        propPage = -1;
        $.ajax({
                    url: "./electiveMgs.do",
                    dataType:"json",
                    cache:false,
                    success:function(j){
                        // console.log(j);
//                        var jd = eval(j);
//                        console.log(jd);
                        var html = theolTemplate("electivemgs",{"mgs":j,"stuInfo":headerInfo,"showProp":showProp});
                        $("#bodyArea").html(html);
                        //$("#ts").html("\u516C\u5171\u57FA\u7840\u8BFE\u5E94\u4FEE\u8BFE\u7A0B\uFF1A9\u95E8        \u5DF2\u4FEE\u8BFE\u7A0B\uFF1A5\u95E8<br />                        \u4E13\u4E1A\u4EFB\u9009\u8BFE\u5E94\u4FEE\u8BFE\u7A0B\uFF1A4\u95E8        \u5DF2\u4FEE\u8BFE\u7A0B\uFF1A2\u95E8<br />                        \u4E13\u4E1A\u9650\u9009\u8BFE\u5E94\u4FEE\u8BFE\u7A0B\uFF1A7\u95E8        \u5DF2\u4FEE\u8BFE\u7A0B\uFF1A3\u95E8");
                        closeLayer();
                    },
                    error:function(e){
                        // console.log(e);
                    }
                }
        );
    }).click();

    $("#finshcourse").click(function(){
        if(scCourseTeachingJson == undefined){
            jsonType = 5;
            getJsonFile();
        }else{
            showFinshCourse();
        }
    });




    $.ajax({
        url: "./electiveStatus.do",
        dataType:"json",
        cache:false,
        success:function(json){
            //console.log(json);
            if(json.status == 0){
                electiveFlag = true;
                showOverflowCapability = json.datas.showOverflowCapability;
                showOverflowCapabilityFree = json.datas.showOverflowCapabilityFree;
                area =  json.datas.area;
                studentAreaId = json.datas.studentAreaId;
                canAdd = json.datas.canAdd;
                isdel =  json.datas.isdel;
                adm_isdel =  json.datas.adm_isdel;
            }else if(json.status == -1){
                electiveFlag = false;
                alertLayer(json.message,json.url);
            }
        }
    });

    // getStatistics();
});

function showFinshCourse(){
    if(curClick == ""){
        curClick = "finshCourse";
        var thisTitile = "已选课程";
        var html = theolTemplate("studentinfo",headerInfo);
        removeStuscFlag = false;
        $("#scedlist").html("<table id=\"scourse\" cellpadding=\"0\" cellspacing=\"0\"  class=\"electivetable\"><caption>"+html+"</caption></table><div class=\"buttonc\"><button onclick='closeLayer()'>关闭</button></div>");
        $.ajax({
            url: "./findElectiveFinshCourse.do",
            cache:false,
            dataType:"json",
            success:function(jd){
                //console.log(jd);
                if(jd.status == 0){
                    var param = {
                        headTitle : attributes,
                        showThList : scPropertyTitleSED,
                        scCourseArrangementJsonData: scCourseArrangementJson,
                        scCourseTeachingJsonData:scCourseTeachingJson,
                        isdel:isdel,
                        prop:"",
                        refresh:false,
                        adm_isdel:adm_isdel,
                        jsonData:jd.datas
                    };
                    $("#scourse").finshCourseGrid(param);

                    if(tmpAddepid.length>0){
                        for(var i=0;i<tmpAddepid.length;i++){
                            $("#stusc"+tmpAddepid[i]).addClass("selected");
                        }
                        tmpAddepid = [];
                    }

                    indexlayer = layer.open({
                        type: 1,
                        title: thisTitile,
                        skin: 'layui-layer-rim',
                        area: ['800px', '500px'],
                        maxmin: true,
                        content: $("#scedlist").html(),
                        cancel: function(){
                            //右上角关闭回调,根据是否有退课操作来刷新选课列表
                            if(removeStuscFlag){
                                showElectScheduleCourseList();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                    if(isMobile)
                        layer.full(indexlayer);
                }else if(jd.status == -1){
                    alertLayer(jd.message,jd.url);
                }
                curClick = "";
            },
            error:function(){
                curClick = "";
            }
        });
        if(schoolCode==1007||schoolCode==1600)
            $("#scedlist").append("<input type='button' onclick='electCoursePay()' value='查看学分缴费详细'/>");
    }
}

function setTitleText(t){
    $("#title").html(t);
}
function showLayer(){
    indexlayer = layer.load(0,{
        shade: [0.1,'#eee'] //0.1透明度的白色背景
    });
}
function closeLayer(){
    layer.close(indexlayer);
    if(removeStuscFlag){
        showElectScheduleCourseList();
    }
}

function alertLayer(mgs,url,iconum){
    var iconum = iconum != undefined ? iconum : 0;
    layer.alert(mgs, {
        skin: 'layui-layer-lan'
        ,icon:iconum
        ,closeBtn: 0
        ,anim: 5 //动画类型
    },function(index){
        if(url != undefined && url != ""){
            location.href=url;
        }else{
            layer.close(index);
        }

    });
}

function getJsonFile(callback){
    var jsonUrl;
    if(jsonType == 0 || jsonType == 1){
        jsonUrl=electcourse_FilePath+ "s" + student.userid+".json";
    }else if(jsonType == 2){
        jsonUrl=electcourse_FilePath+"ScStuCourseFreeList.json";
    }else if(jsonType == 3){
        jsonUrl=electcourse_FilePath+"ScCourseArrangementList.json";
    }else if(jsonType == 4){
        jsonUrl=electcourse_FilePath+"ScStuCourseFreeRestrict.json";
    }else if(jsonType == 5){
        jsonUrl=electcourse_FilePath+"Schoolteaching.json";
    }
    //$.getScript(jsonUrl);
    $.ajax({
        url:jsonUrl,
        dataType: "script",
        //dataType: "jsonp",
        contentType: 'text/json,charset=utf-8',
        jsonpCallback: "jcallback",  //指定回调函数名称
        success: function(){
            //console.info("jcallback success");
        },
        error:function(){
            // console.info("jcallback error");
            //alertLayer("\u52A0\u8F7D\u5931\u8D25");
            if(jsonType == 0 || jsonType == 1){
                scStuCourseJson = "";
                preShowElectScheduleCourseList();
            }else if(jsonType == 2){
                scStuCourseFreeJson = "";
                preShowElectScheduleCourseList();
            }else if(jsonType == 3){
                scCourseArrangementJson = "";
            }else if(jsonType == 4){
                propRestrictionJson = "";
                preShowElectScheduleCourseList();
            }else if(jsonType == 5){
                scCourseTeachingJson = "";
                showFinshCourse();
            }
            closeLayer();
        }
    })
}

function jcallback(jsonData){
    if(jsonType == 0 || jsonType == 1){
        scStuCourseJson = jsonData;
        preShowElectScheduleCourseList();
    }else if(jsonType == 2){
        scStuCourseFreeJson = jsonData;
        preShowElectScheduleCourseList();
    }else if(jsonType == 3){
        //加载完课程安排后，接着加载课程班任课教师
        scCourseArrangementJson = jsonData;
        jsonType = 5;
        getJsonFile();
    }else if(jsonType == 4){
        propRestrictionJson = jsonData;
        if(jsonData !=undefined && jsonData.length > 0 ){
            for(var i = 0,j = jsonData.length;i<j;i++){
                var o = jsonData[i];
                if(o.prop == "classid" && o.list.length > 0){
                    for(var x = 0,y = o.list.length;x<y;x++){
                        addClassIdPropRestriction(o.list[x]);
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }
            propRestrictionJson = jsonData;
            preShowElectScheduleCourseList();
        }
    }else if(jsonType == 5){
        scCourseTeachingJson = jsonData;
        //仅加载任课教师JSON
        //showFinshCourse();
    }
}

function addClassIdPropRestriction(o){
    var f = true;
    for(var i = 0,j = classIdPropRestrictionArr.length;i<j;i++){
        var c = classIdPropRestrictionArr[i];
        if(c.epid == o.epid){
            f = false;
            c.pushClassid(o.classid);
            break;
        }
    }
    if(f){
        var newclass = new ClassIdPropRestriction(o.epid, o.status, o.classid);
        classIdPropRestrictionArr.push(newclass);
    }
}

function preShowElectScheduleCourseList(){
    if(propRestrictionJson == undefined){
        // console.log("start" + new Date());
        jsonType = 4;
        getJsonFile();
    }else{
        showElectScheduleCourseList();
        closeLayer();
    }
}
function showElectScheduleCourseList(){
    if(propPage != -1){
        var courseJson = scStuCourseJson;
        var titleStr = scPropertyTitleMR;
        var showOverflow = showOverflowCapability;
        if(propPage == 2){
            courseJson = scStuCourseFreeJson;
            titleStr = scPropertyTitleF;
            showOverflow = showOverflowCapabilityFree;
        }
        $("#bodyArea").html("").html("<table id=\"grid\" cellpadding=\"0\" cellspacing=\"0\" class=\"electivetable\"><caption>待选课程</caption></table>");
        $.ajax({
            url:"./findSelectedCidList.do",
            data:{"prop":propPage},
            cache:false,
            success:function(selectedCidList){
                var param = {
                    headTitle : attributes,
                    showThList:titleStr,
                    selectedCidList:selectedCidList,
                    prop:propPage,
                    studentAreaId:studentAreaId,
                    scCourseArrangementJsonData: scCourseArrangementJson,
                    showOverflowCapability:showOverflow,
                    canAdd:canAdd,
                    schedulegroupid:scheduleGroupId,
                    propRestrictionJson:propRestrictionJson,
                    classIdPropRestrictionArr:classIdPropRestrictionArr,
                    student:student,
                    batchMaxnum:batchMaxnum,
                    searchBar:searchBar,
                    showSingleAddBtn:showSingleAddBtn,
                    filterFreeGroupList:filterFreeGroupList,
                    defaultShowClasses:defaultShowClasses,
                    jsonData:courseJson
                };
                $("#grid").electiveGrid(param);
                scheduleGroupId = "";
                curClick = "";
            },
            error:function(){
                curClick = "";
            }
        })
    }
}


var result = [];

function eletivePreAddCourse(type,parmasjson){
    electiveType = type;
    addCourseParmasJson = "";
    if(parmasjson != undefined && parmasjson != "")
        addCourseParmasJson = parmasjson;
    else if(type == "multe"){
        if($("#grid input[name='epid']:checked").size()>0){
            $("#selectednum").text("0");
            $("#batchsubbtn").removeClass("electiveBtn").addClass("electiveBtn_able").prop("disabled","disabled");
            var array = new Array();
            addCourseParmasJson = "{";
            $("#grid input[name='epid']:checked").each(function(){
                array.push($(this).val());
            });
            addCourseParmasJson = {"epid":array.join(",")};
            //console.log(addCourseParmasJson);
        }
    }
    if(captchaCode){
        show_captcha();
    }else{
        electiveAddCourse();
    }

}

function electiveAddCourse(){
    showLayer();
    if(addCourseParmasJson != ""){
        $.ajax({
            url:"./electiveSelectCourseAdd.do",
            data:addCourseParmasJson,
            dataType:"json",
            cache:false,
            success:function(j){
                if(j.status == 0){
                    closeLayer();
                    showElectiveAddCourseResult(j);
                }else{
                    alertLayer("\u9009\u8bfe\u5931\u8d25");
                    closeLayer();
                }
            },
            error:function(){
                alertLayer("\u9009\u8bfe\u5931\u8d25");
                closeLayer();
            }
        });
    }else{
        closeLayer();
    }
}

function showElectiveAddCourseResult(res){
    if(addCourseParmasJson != ""){
        if(res.result != undefined){
            var j = res.result;
            if(j.status == 0){
                alertLayer(j.message,undefined,1);
            }else{
                alertLayer(j.message,undefined,2);
            }
            if(j.epid != undefined){
                if(j.status == 0){
                    filterCourse(j.epid);
                    showTopInfo(propPage);
                }else{
                    $("#sc"+ j.epid).remove();
                }
                refreshCountClassesNum();
            }
        }else if(res.resultList != undefined){
            var showHtml = "<table cellpadding=\"0\" cellspacing=\"0\" class=\"electivetable\" ><thead><tr><th width=\"40%\">课程名称</th><th>\u7ED3\u679C</th></tr></thead><tbody>";
            var r = res.resultList;
            for(var i=0;i< r.length;i++){
                //console.log(r[i]);
                showHtml = showHtml + "<tr><td class=\"padding25\">";
                if(r[i].status  == 0){
                    filterCourse(r[i].epid);
                    showHtml = showHtml + "<span class=\"pass\">" + (r[i].coursename != undefined ? r[i].coursename : "") + "</span>";
                }else{
                    $("#sc"+r[i].epid).remove();
                    showHtml = showHtml + "<span class=\"failed\">" +  (r[i].coursename != undefined ? r[i].coursename : "") + "</span>";
                }

                showHtml = showHtml + "</td><td class=\"padding25\">";
                if(r[i].status == -1){
                    showHtml = showHtml + "\u9009\u8bfe\u5931\u8d25";
                }else{
                    showHtml = showHtml + r[i].message;
                }
                showHtml = showHtml +"</td></tr>";
            }
            showHtml = showHtml + "</tbody></table>";
            showTopInfo(propPage);
            refreshCountClassesNum();
            indexlayer = layer.open({
                type: 1,
                title: "\u7ED3\u679C",
                skin: 'layui-layer-rim',
                area: ['800px', '500px'],
                maxmin:true,
                content: showHtml
            });
            if(isMobile)
                layer.full(indexlayer);

        }

    }
}












































































function fastAddSingleCourse(){
    var _pcourseid = $.trim($("#fastscpcourseid").val());
    var _seq = $.trim($("#fastscseq").val());
    if(_pcourseid == "" || _seq == ""){
        alertLayer("\u8BFE\u7A0B\u53F7\u548C\u8BFE\u5E8F\u53F7\u5747\u4E0D\u53EF\u4E3A\u7A7A\uFF01");
        closeLayer();
        return ;
    }
    var r = /^\+?[1-9][0-9]*$/;
    if(!r.test(_seq)){
        alertLayer("\u8BFE\u5E8F\u53F7\u5FC5\u987B\u4E3A\u6B63\u6574\u6570\uFF01");
        closeLayer();
        return ;
    }

    eletivePreAddCourse("fast",{"pcourseid":_pcourseid,"seq":_seq});
    //electiveAddSingleCourse(_pcourseid,_seq,undefined);
}

function filterCourse(epid){
    if(epid != undefined){
        var courseStr = $("#sc"+epid).data("cid");
        //console.log($("tr[data-cid="+courseStr+"]").size());
        $("tr[data-cid='"+courseStr+"']").remove();
    }
}


function removeStusc(epid,rollId,o,refresh){
    var coursename = $(o).parent().parent().find("#finshcoursename_"+epid).text();
    var removeFlag = true;
    layer.confirm(coursename +",您确定要删除吗？", {
        btn: ['确定','取消']
    }, function(){
        if(removeFlag){
            removeFlag = false;
            $.ajax({
                url:"./electiveRemovestusc.do",
                data:{"epid":epid,"rollId":rollId},
                dataType:"json",
                success:function(j){
                    layer.alert(j.message, {
                        skin: 'layui-layer-lan'
                        ,icon:0
                        ,closeBtn: 0
                        ,anim: 5
                    },function(index){
                        layer.close(index);
                        if(j.status == 0){
                            $(o).parent().parent().remove();
                            $("#stusc"+epid).remove();
                            removeStuscFlag = true;
                            if(refresh != null && refresh)
                                showElectScheduleCourseList();
                        }
                    });

                    
                },
                error:function(){
                    alertLayer("\u9000\u8bfe\u5931\u8d25");
                }
            });
        }
    }, function(){
    });
}

function initscpage(title,cprop){
    showLayer();
    $("#topInfo").html("");
    setTitleText(title);
    if(cprop != undefined && (batchMaxnum > 1 || showCourseGroupStat || showCourseDisplayMgs)){
        $("#electivefoot").show();
        $("#electivefoot > button").hide();
        if(batchMaxnum > 1)
            $("#batchsubbtn").show();
        if(showCourseGroupStat)
            $("#showscgstat").show();
        if(showCourseDisplayMgs)
            $("#showscgmgs").show();
    }else{
        $("#electivefoot").hide();
    }
}

function showScheduleGroupStat(){
    $.ajax({
        url:"./findScheduleGroupStat.do",
        data:{"propSc":propPage},
        dataType:"json",
        cache:false,
        success:function(jd){
            if(jd.status == 0){
                var showHtml = theolTemplate("schedulegroupgtat",{"list":jd.datas.stuCourseGroupStatList,"memo":jd.datas.memo});
                indexlayer = layer.open({
                    type: 1,
                    title: "按照课组统计历年已选学分、门数",
                    skin: 'layui-layer-rim',
                    area: ['800px', '500px'],
                    maxmin:true,
                    content: showHtml
                });
                if(isMobile)
                    layer.full(indexlayer);
            }else if(jd.status == -1){
                alertLayer(jd.message,jd.url);
            }
        },
        error:function(){
            alertLayer("error");
        }
    });
}

function showCourseMgs(){
    $.ajax({
        url:"./findPropCourseMgs.do",

                    type: 1,

                    skin: 'layui-layer-rim',
                    area: ['800px', '500px'],
                    maxmin:true,
                    content: showHtml
                });
                if(isMobile)
                    layer.full(indexlayer);
            }else if(jd.status == -1){
                alertLayer(jd.message,jd.url);
            }
        },
        error:function(){
            alertLayer("error");
        }
    });
}

function showStatistics(){
    if(electivestatistics != ""){
        var html = theolTemplate("electivestatistics",{"list":electivestatistics});
        $("#ts").html(html);
    }else{
        $.ajax({
            url: "./findCourseStatistics.do",
            data:{"userid":"740151"},
            dataType:"json",
            cache:false,
            success:function(j){
                electivestatistics = j;
                var html = theolTemplate("electivestatistics",{"list":electivestatistics});
                $("#ts").html(html);
            },
            error:function(){
                // $("#ts").html("");
            }
        });
    }
}

function getStatistics(){
    $.ajax({
        url: "./findCourseStatistics.do",
        data:{"userid":"740151"},
        dataType:"json",
        cache:false,
        success:function(j){
            electivestatistics = j;
        },
        error:function(){
        }
    });
}


function refreshCountClassesNum(){
    $("#countClassesNum>em").text($("#grid tbody>tr:visible").size());
}































var closeFlag;
function closebeforeWin(){
    event.returnValue="关闭当前窗口将退出系统？";
    closeFlag = true;
}

function closeWin(){
    // console.log(closeFlag);
    if(closeFlag)
        location.href="/academic/logout_security_check";
}

function showTopInfo(prop){
    var caption = "已选必修课程";
    if(prop == 1 )
        caption = "已选限选课程";
    else if(prop == 2)
        caption = "已选任选课程";

}

function show_captcha(){
    var captchaHtml = "<div id=\"captcha\" >" +
            "<div class=\"codeImg\"><img  id=\"jcaptcha\" onclick=\"refresh_jcaptcha()\" src=\"./getCaptcha.do\" alt=\"点击刷新验证码\"  style=\"cursor:pointer;\" width=\"150\" height=\"30\"/></div>" +
            "<div class=\"codetext\"><input type=\"text\" placeholder=\"请输入验证码\" class=\"codeText\" id=\"jcaptchatext\" /></div>" +
            "<div class=\"message\" id=\"message\"></div><div class=\"buttonc\"><button type=\"button\" onclick=\"validCaptcha()\"  class=\"electiveBtn\" >确定</button></div></div>";

    indexlayer = layer.open({
        type: 1,
        title: "\u9A8C\u8BC1\u7801",
        skin: 'layui-layer-rim',
        area: ['300px', '150px'],
        maxmin:true,
        content: captchaHtml
    });
    refresh_jcaptcha();
    if(isMobile)
        layer.full(indexlayer);
}
function refresh_jcaptcha() {
    var obj = document.getElementById("jcaptcha");
    obj.src = "./getCaptcha.do?" + Math.random();
}

function validCaptcha() {
    var v = $("#jcaptchatext").val();
    var errDiv = $("#message");
    if (v == null || v == "") {
        errDiv.text("\u8bf7\u8f93\u5165\u9a8c\u8bc1\u7801\uff01");
        return false;
    }
    $.ajax({
        type:'post',
        url:"./checkCaptcha.do?captchaCode=" + v,
        dataType:'text',
        success:function (data) {
            if (data == "true") { //验证码输入正确
                closeLayer();
                electiveAddCourse();
            } else {
                errDiv.text("\u9a8c\u8bc1\u7801\u4e0d\u6b63\u786e\uff01");
                $("img#jcaptcha").click();//更新验证码
            }
        }
    });

}
